senses.en_definition: A proper name used as a surname and in names of places, people and organisations.

etymology.historical_story: Templeton can travel from a family name into an institution's identity. Sir John Templeton established the John Templeton Foundation in 1987, giving his surname a public association with research and philanthropy. This documents one cultural use of the name; it does not establish which Templeton the input denotes or prove the surname's original derivation. [Foundation biography](https://www.templeton.org/about/sir-john-templeton).
